think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s data type and allowed values. 2) Check whether it is a numerical knob with an inherent ordering (e.g., integer/float). 3) If numerical, check for sentinel values (e.g., -1, 0) that trigger a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/infinite) compared to normal numeric behavior. 4) If the knob is boolean or enumerated (non-numeric), it does not fit the ‘special numerical knob’ definition; classify as not special. 5) If special, record the sentinel value(s).
